scripts.install:all: concurrently "yarn install" "yarn --cwd api-gateway install" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service install" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service install" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal install" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal install" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv sync)" "(cd backend/facial_recognition_server && uv sync)"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "api,institute,saas,ai_core,voice_agent,face_rec,inst_portal,sass_portal" -c "cyan,green,magenta,white,orange,pink,blue,red" "yarn --cwd api-gateway run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run start:dev" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv run python main.py)" "(cd backend/voice_agent && uv run python -m app --port 8002 --reload)" "(cd backend/facial_recognition_server && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004 --reload)" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run dev" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run dev"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -n "api,institute,saas,ai_core,voice_agent,face_rec" -c "cyan,green,magenta,white,orange,pink" "yarn --cwd api-gateway run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run start:dev" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run start:dev" "(cd backend/ai_core && uv run python main.py)" "(cd backend/voice_agent && uv run python -m app --port 8002 --reload)" "(cd backend/facial_recognition_server && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004 --reload)"
scripts.start:frontend: concurrently -k -n "inst_portal,sass_portal" -c "blue,red" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run dev" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run dev"
scripts.dev:face_rec: (cd backend/facial_recognition_server && unset VIRTUAL_ENV && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8004 --reload)
scripts.build:all: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway run build" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run build" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run build" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run build" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run build"
scripts.test: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway test" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service test" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service test"
scripts.lint: concurrently "yarn --cwd api-gateway run lint" "yarn --cwd backend/institute_service run lint" "yarn --cwd backend/saas_service run lint" "yarn --cwd frontend/institute_protal run lint" "yarn --cwd frontend/sass_protal run lint"
